correctness.rationale: The four ordered endpoints have three exhaustive pairings, with 1/4,1/4,1/2 conditional no-trail probability for a labeled collector; two players are symmetric and mutually exclusive. Nested-interval containment is twice each CDF-composition variance. Orthogonal conditional expectations of the Bernoulli comparison \(1\{X<Y\}\) bound their sum by 1/4 and a disjoint-support continuous mixture realizes the whole range. Exponential moment integrals give the stated rate-ratio rational expression and the 2/3-gap factors positively. The bundled standard-library exact rational script executes 352 checks, including all 24 arrival permutations for each of 324 integer rate pairs; infinite generality relies on proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural minimal two-type version of the two-player coupon ballot problem with independent first-arrival clocks, and it gives a complete sharp distribution-free probability envelope rather than a single numerical case. The strict reduction of the upper bound from 3/4 to 2/3 in the exponential/Poisson clock subclass characterizes the effect of memoryless waiting, suggests comparison to larger systems and supplies an exact benchmark for simulation; no larger-type result is claimed.
